quote.commercialBody: Commercial cleaning rates are tailored to your space and schedule. Contact us for a free assessment.

services.sectionSubhead: Professional cleaning for every need — residential, rental, and commercial. Proudly serving Cornwall and surrounding communities.

standard.title: Standard Cleaning
standard.description: Regular maintenance cleaning to keep your home fresh. Ideal for weekly or biweekly visits — counters, floors, bathrooms, and living areas.

deep.title: Deep Clean
deep.description: A thorough top-to-bottom clean including baseboards, inside appliances, and hard-to-reach areas. Perfect for a seasonal reset or first-time clean.

moveout.title: Move-Out Cleaning
moveout.description: Leave your old home spotless for the next owners or your landlord's inspection. We handle every surface so you get your deposit back.

postconstruction.title: Post-Construction
postconstruction.description: Construction dust and debris require specialist attention. We safely remove fine particles, adhesive residue, and packaging from every surface.

airbnb.title: Airbnb Turnover
airbnb.description: Fast, reliable turnovers between guest stays — typically completed in the 11am–3pm window. Linen change, sanitize, and guest-ready staging included.

commercial.title: Commercial Cleaning
commercial.description: Tailored cleaning programs for offices, retail, and business facilities. Flexible scheduling, volume pricing, and dedicated account management.
